title: Fifteen pages that must all be held at once

steps.post: @{agent} the department's meeting minutes are at {FIX}/minutes/ — one page per monthly meeting. Read every month and tell me the total of all approved expenditures across them, and which single month approved the largest amount.

pass: The reply gives $78,565 as the total and September 2025 ($15,220) as the largest month.

checks.text: All fifteen monthly pages were read at least once.
How the total was computed: in the model's text, or in a shell call; and whether intermediate amounts were written down in assistant text between reads.
Economy: the index plus fifteen pages is sixteen reads; name every read beyond that and why it happened.
